subject: Marketplace listing: Nimbus Retail - product page copy and SKU/pricing framing
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimbusretail.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nimbusretail.com
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing kick-off + quick copy asks

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier — Nimbus is excited to get our AWS Marketplace listing live and to explore co-sell motion alignment. Procurement looped me in to get the legal/sku/pricing questions started. A few asks to kick off the listing and landing page copy: 

- We need a one-line product summary (<=12 words), a 2-sentence elevator, and 3 bullets for the hero.
- Suggested SKU names (trial vs production) and an initial pricing band for public listing + private offer note.
- Any required legal footnote language for BYOL / data residency.

I'll attach our branding files and the internal pricing matrix. Goal: landing draft by EOD Monday so our field team can start co-sell outreach next week.

Attached: nimbus_brand_assets.zip, pricing_matrix.xlsx

Appreciate it — Liam

--
Liam O'Connor
Product Partnerships | Nimbus Retail
liam.oconnor@nimbusretail.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing kick-off + quick copy asks

Liam — thanks, got the assets. We can definitely hit a draft Monday; looping in Marissa (marketplace copy lead) and Jonas (partner ops) to own the page and SKU mapping. A couple quick clarifying Qs so the draft is actionable: 

1) Is Nimbus planning a time-limited trial (30-day) or an always-on free tier?
2) Do you want the public listing to include pricing bands, or do you prefer “Contact us / Request trial” + Private Offer for committed pricing?
3) Any mandatory security claims (SOC2, HIPAA) you want surfaced on the hero?

If you can answer 1–3 we’ll produce a hero, 2-sentence elevator, 3 bullets, sample SKU names, and a recommended pricing footnote for legal review.

Thanks — Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: DRAFT: Nimbus AWS listing copy + SKU suggestions (internal)

Folks — attaching the first draft for internal review (see inline). I kept the language PLG-friendly with callouts for co-sell. Attached: listing_draft_v1.docx (also copied below). Please flag any deal/legal blockers before I send to Nimbus.

--- listing_draft_v1.docx (excerpt) ---
Subject line for console: Nimbus Retail — Real-time inventory prediction and automated replenishment
Hero one-liner (<=12 words): "Inventory intelligence that prevents stockouts and reduces carrying cost."
2-sentence elevator: "Nimbus uses time-series forecasting and real-time telemetry to predict demand and automate replenishment. Deploy via AWS Marketplace for turnkey setup with enterprise controls and telemetry into your data lake."
3 hero bullets:
- Forecast accuracy up to 25% better than baseline models (typical ROI within 8 weeks)
- Turnkey integrations: S3/Redshift connectors, prebuilt Lambda orchestration, native event triggers
- Secure by-design: SOC 2 Type II, customer-managed keys, and VPC options

Proposed SKUs:
- Nimbus-Core (30-day trial) — metered by SKUs (calls/month)
- Nimbus-Scale (annual, reserved capacity) — predictable throughput pricing
- Nimbus-Enterprise (private offer) — dedicated instance + premium support

Pricing footnote suggestion for public listing:
- "Public listing displays example metered rates. Final pricing available through Private Offer or contract. Volume discounts and reserved commitments will be shown in Private Offer negotiations."

Legal/regulatory language placeholder:
- "Data processed by Nimbus may be stored in AWS regions selected by the customer. Nimbus supports customer-managed KMS. See SLA and Data Processing Addendum for details."

Co-sell callout (hero badge):
- "Available for co-sell with Redwood Inference — reach out to your Redwood rep for joint demos and proof-of-value pilots."

--- end excerpt ---

Marissa

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimbusretail.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 11:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DRAFT: Nimbus AWS listing copy + SKU suggestions (internal)

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few notes from product and procurement: 

- One-liner looks good; can we tighten the elevator to emphasize "time-to-value" (e.g., first ROI in 6–8 weeks).
- SKUs: prefer "Nimbus Trial" (30-day), "Nimbus Standard" (pay-as-you-go), "Nimbus Reserved" (1y commitment). Avoid the word "Enterprise" in SKU name — legal flagged as ambiguous.
- Pricing: procurement prefers example banding on public page for transparency (we can show a sample per-call rate and a note that private offers will reflect discounts).
- Security: add "PCI-ready" to the hero bullets — important for retail customers who handle payments.

Also attached is a short RFP excerpt from our procurement team — requesting Marketplace contract SLA minimums. See nimbus_rfp.pdf.

If you can push an updated public-facing draft with the SKU name tweaks and the ROI emphasis we can unblock field enablement next week.

Best,
Liam

--
Liam O'Connor
Product Partnerships | Nimbus Retail

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimbusretail.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DRAFT: Nimbus AWS listing copy + SKU suggestions (internal)

Thanks all — quick updates I pushed into listing_draft_v2 (linked below). Summary of changes for Nimbus/Procurement: 

- Elevator tightened to "Deliver measurable ROI in 6–8 weeks with turnkey inventory forecasting and automated replenishment."
- SKU names updated: "Nimbus Trial" (30d), "Nimbus Standard" (PAYG metered), "Nimbus Reserved" (1y commitment).
- Hero bullet updated to include PCI-ready.
- Pricing footnote now shows sample per-call rate: "Example listing: $0.0025 per call — public rates are indicative; private offers include commitment discounts."
- Added legal placeholder for Data Processing Addendum and Customer KMS note.

Next steps: Marissa — please review tone and compress hero bullets to single-line callouts for the AWS product page. Jonas — can you confirm whether the private offer SKU mapping and AMI tagging needs a separate SKU code? If not, we'll map Reserved to a Private Offer with the same SKU but separate entitlement.

I plan to send the external-facing doc to Liam on Monday morning unless there are objections.

Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
